story-context.executive-summary: Story 1.16 adds comprehensive OpenAPI documentation to the Control Sequence API. The codebase already has substantial documentation - DTOs have Field descriptions and examples. The main gaps are error response documentation in route decorators and enhanced endpoint docstrings.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: All endpoints have docstrings visible in /docs
